title: every post shows a picture, and every Page can have a Page picture

criteria.text: Every Page, of every kind, may set one optional Page picture: same field, flow and copy for every kind; a Page without one publishes and shows as today
criteria.note: `groups.picture_url`; `group.update` and `update_draft` take `pictureUrl`; a 'Page picture' picker beside Photo in the Page editor for both kinds [V]. Checked: [guards F099.1] in `PageEditor.test.tsx`, `update.test.ts`, `update-draft.test.ts`. Reviewed: #502 `Reviewed by:`. Smoked: `page-edit` opens green (10-21 to 10-23), but the picker needs a tap, which the read-only smoke does not do. Re-read 2026-11-20 [V]: post card and Page picture code unchanged except F134 (#1278), which removed the withheld announcement card and let signed-out readers see posts and their photos; #1360 (11-18) touched the venue importer only.

criteria.text: A Page with no Page picture shows its kind's placeholder image, identical on every load, to every viewer
criteria.note: `DefaultArt` by kind on the Page and the post card; since #969 (10-19) the signed-out withheld card draws it too when the Page has no photo [V]. Checked: no `[guards F099.2]` marker (#632); F082.8's guard (#908) asserts the kind's default art on a photoless Page's Explore card as a side effect. Earlier smoke (10-21 to 10-23): `page` and `explore` green on 10-21 to 10-23, after the last merge, a load check only. Smoked: yes; smoke-live was green on 05178ea (11-19), after the last merge (#1360, 9882024), on the Page and Explore routes, signed out and signed in, which draw the placeholder [V gh run]; a load check, not a pixel check [A]. Re-read 2026-11-20 [V]: post card and Page picture code unchanged except F134 (#1278), which removed the withheld announcement card and let signed-out readers see posts and their photos; #1360 (11-18) touched the venue importer only.

criteria.text: A post may carry one photo of its own; the composer completes without one; a second is refused
criteria.note: `page_posts.photo_url`, one URL in `group.post_create` and `post_edit`, never a list [V]. Checked: [guards F099.3] in `post.test.ts` (second refused), `PagePosts.test.tsx`, `tests/migrations-post-photos.test.ts`. Reviewed: #498 and #502. Smoked: the composer is not opened by smoke-live. Re-read 2026-11-20 [V]: post card and Page picture code unchanged except F134 (#1278), which removed the withheld announcement card and let signed-out readers see posts and their photos; #1360 (11-18) touched the venue importer only.

criteria.text: A post's photo belongs to that post only; it does not appear on the Page as a Page photo
criteria.note: Create and edit write `page_posts` only; `resolvePagePosts` selects no `groups` column [V]. Checked: [guards F099.4] in `post.test.ts` (no `groups` update on create) and `page-posts.test.ts`; the edit path is not asserted, though the handler reads clean. Re-read 2026-11-20 [V]: post card and Page picture code unchanged except F134 (#1278), which removed the withheld announcement card and let signed-out readers see posts and their photos; #1360 (11-18) touched the venue importer only.

criteria.text: The Page picture and a post photo use the existing upload path: WebP only, metadata stripped, the uploader's own folder, 5 MB at most, verified against the stored bytes
criteria.note: `isOwnMediaUrl` on both; the WebP, 5 MB and byte checks come from the reused F070 `PagePhotoPicker` path [A, not re-read]. Checked: [guards F099.5] in `post.test.ts`, `update.test.ts`, `update-draft.test.ts` (own folder; the rest is F070's). Re-read 2026-11-20 [V]: post card and Page picture code unchanged except F134 (#1278), which removed the withheld announcement card and let signed-out readers see posts and their photos; #1360 (11-18) touched the venue importer only.

criteria.text: Every post card shows exactly one image on its Page, in browse and on Home: the post's visible photo, else the Page's visible Page picture, else the kind placeholder
criteria.note: `browse_feed` resolves `photo_url` and `photo_source` in SQL; Page posts and `BrowseResultCard` fall to `DefaultArt` [V]. Since 10-16: #931 (#922 B) made the post card text-led with the one image as an 80px thumbnail, `Reviewed by:` and the F099.6 checks still pass; #983, #989 and #992 (review-skipped, image `src` and `loading` attributes only) serve card-sized WebP at 1x and 2x, the same image. Checked: [guards F099.6] in `tests/migrations-browse-feed.test.ts` (three cases), `BrowseResultCard.test.tsx`, `PagePosts.test.tsx`. Shipped: deploy-health green on 0ebfaa1, 4d4417e, 0455ca2, 3753fd2. Earlier smoke (10-21 to 10-23): `explore` and `page` green on 10-23 after every merge; `root` (Home) was last opened green on 10-19, before the sizing PRs; a load check only. Smoked: yes; smoke-live was green on 05178ea (11-19), after the last merge, on the Explore and Page routes where the card shows its one image [V gh run]; Home (`root`) was not in that run. Since 10-23 the card was reworked (#1126, #1143, #1168, #1170, all `Reviewed by:`); the F099.6 and F099.10 checks still pass [V]. Re-read 2026-11-20 [V]: post card and Page picture code unchanged except F134 (#1278), which removed the withheld announcement card and let signed-out readers see posts and their photos; #1360 (11-18) touched the venue importer only.

criteria.text: Visible means neither hidden nor removed, resolved in SQL, so a hidden or removed URL does not reach the browser and the card falls to the next image
criteria.note: `browse_feed` takes the post photo or Page picture only when its hidden and removed stamps are null; `resolvePagePosts` nulls the URL [V]. Checked: [guards F099.7] in `tests/migrations-browse-feed.test.ts` (hidden or removed post photo never leaves the database; hidden Page picture and photo leave no URL) and `page-posts.test.ts`. #633's title still names 7, which is guarded; 11a remains. Re-read 2026-11-20 [V]: post card and Page picture code unchanged except F134 (#1278), which removed the withheld announcement card and let signed-out readers see posts and their photos; #1360 (11-18) touched the venue importer only.
